description: Audit a form's markup and its error messages, with extra care for sign-up and payment forms. Pass `html` or a public `url`, and optionally `errors` (error message strings, one per line). Checks programmatic labels and placeholder-only labels (WCAG 1.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2), autocomplete tokens on personal data fields (1.3.5), wrong input types and inputmode for phone, email, card and one-time codes, password fields that block paste or lack a show-password option, required fields not marked in text or in aria, fieldset and legend on radio and checkbox groups, error wiring (aria-describedby, aria-invalid, live regions, error summary), disabled submit buttons, CAPTCHA without an alternative (3.3.8), and redundant entry (3.3.7). Each error string is checked for saying what happened, saying how to fix it, blame, jargon, the word invalid, and generic wording. Findings carry criterion, severity and fix. Reads static markup only; color-only errors and script-built fields need a browser check.

errors.description: Optional error messages to review, one per line.

html.description: Form or page HTML. Use this or url.

url.description: Public page to fetch and audit.
